map.已用年限 =（今天 − 首次使用日期）÷ 365.25；剩余年限 = 参考安全年: Used years = (today − first-use date) ÷ 365.25; remaining years = reference safe life − used years; replacement date = first-use date + reference safe life; safety progress = used years ÷ reference safe life × 100%
map.安全年限为行业标准与厂商说明的参考上限，不是强制报废线；超期后应重点检查电源线、: Safe service life is a reference upper limit from industry standards and maker instructions, not a mandatory scrap date. After it, check cords, plugs, grounding and residual-current protection. Date differences use 365.25 days/year.

map.内胆、镁棒、漏电保护与接地: Tank, magnesium anode, residual-current protection and grounding
map.燃烧室、排烟管、燃气软管与一氧化碳报警: Combustion chamber, flue, gas hose and CO alarm
map.电机绝缘、油垢、电源线与止回阀: Motor insulation, grease, cord and check valve
map.电源板、背光、散热与插座接触: Power board, backlight, heat dissipation and socket contact
map.门封、磁控管、高压电容与接地: Door seal, magnetron, high-voltage capacitor and grounding
map.内胆涂层、电源线、温控与插座: Inner-pot coating, cord, thermostat and socket
map.电机轴承、电源线、摇头机构与绝缘: Motor bearing, cord, oscillation mechanism and insulation
map.年限为常见家用条件下的参考值；高频、潮湿、油烟、长时间满负荷会加速老化，具体以铭: These lives are references for common household conditions; frequent use, humidity, grease and long full-load operation accelerate aging. Follow the nameplate, manual and maker's advice.
map.首次使用日期比购买日期更接近实际；只有发票日期时，可按购买日期估算并预留余量。: First use is closer to reality than purchase date; if only the invoice date is known, use it and leave a margin.
map.安全使用年限不是强制报废线；到期后应检查电源线、插头、内部接线、接地与漏电保护。: Safe service life is not a mandatory scrap date; at the limit, check cords, plugs, internal wiring, grounding and residual-current protection.
map.出现电线发硬、插头发热、异味、跳闸、外壳带电感或燃气报警时，立即停用并更换。: Stop using and replace immediately if the cord hardens, the plug overheats, odor appears, the breaker trips, the shell feels live or a gas alarm sounds.
map.购买价仅用于摊薄年均成本；留空或填 0 时不计算成本，不影响年限判断。: Purchase price is only for annualized cost; blank or 0 means no cost calculation and does not affect the age check.
map.结果为提醒与预算参考，不替代厂商检修与专业电工判断。: Results are reminders and budget references, not a substitute for maker service or a qualified electrician.

map.二手交易：先查年限，如实告知买家；超期承压、燃气类家电优先走正规回收。: Second-hand sales: check the age and tell buyers; past-limit pressure or gas appliances should go to formal recycling.
map.租房安全：入住前核对热水器、空调、洗衣机的使用年限与漏电保护。: Rental safety: before moving in, check the age and residual-current protection of water heaters, air conditioners and washing machines.

Check the door seal, compressor start-up, cord and grounding, and replace soon if energy use rises or cooling worsens.
map.超过安全使用年限就一定要换吗？: Must I replace an appliance once past its safe life?
map.不一定立即报废，但风险明显上升。应重点检查电源线、插头、内部接线、接地与漏电保护: Not necessarily scrap immediately, but risk rises. Check cords, plugs, internal wiring, grounding and residual-current protection; stop and replace if the cord hardens, the plug overheats, odor appears, the breaker trips or the shell feels live.
map.年限从购买日还是首次使用日算？: Should the life count from purchase or first use?
map.以首次通电使用日更接近实际；只有发票日期时用购买日估算并预留余量。长期闲置未通电: First powered use is closer to reality; if only the invoice date is known, use it and leave a margin. Insulation still ages while idle, but loaded life is longer.
map.安全使用年限和保修期是一回事吗？: Is safe service life the same as the warranty period?
map.不是。保修期是厂商免费维修承诺，通常 1–3 年；安全使用年限是行业标准给出的参: No. Warranty is a free-repair promise, usually 1–3 years; safe service life is a reference upper limit from industry standards, commonly 5–10 years. Past warranty does not mean replacement, and reaching the safe limit does not mean it is safe to keep pushing.
map.超期家电还能卖二手吗？: Can an appliance past its safe life be sold second-hand?
map.可以，但应如实告知年限与维修史，并确认电源线、插头、接地完好。燃气、承压或大功率: Yes, but disclose the age and repair history and confirm the cord, plug and grounding are intact. Past-limit gas, pressure or high-power appliances should go to formal recycling rather than to buyers unaware of the risk.
